scheme_name: Dattopant Thengadi Mratak Shramik Aarthik Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: The worker must be employed in an establishment registered under the Factories Act, 1948
The worker’s monthly salary (basic salary plus dearness allowance) must not exceed ₹15,000
The application must be submitted within one year of the worker’s death
Financial assistance is payable to the worker’s spouse or dependent (son or unmarried daughter), or to the mother/father if the worker was unmarried
benefits_summary: Provides a one‑time financial assistance of ₹1,00,000 to the family of a deceased worker.
documents_required: Scanned copy of the verified application form
